user_scope: Independent report-only object interval calibration and one held-out test; physical paused; no policy changes.

sampling.distribution: IID draws from fixed equal family / 3 depth-stratum / regular-vs-part-mismatch mixture; no quota correction or redraw.

sensors: Clean first-hit RGB-D, exact pose, ideal visible instance and category masks; same public sensor constants as B8.

calibration.s0_source: B8 selected-scale training12 only; object median of four-condition absolute median-prediction errors, then median objects.
calibration.q_source: New calibration24 only; per-object maximum normalized outside-raw95-interval residual across exactly four conditions.

evaluation.target: Private source geometry projected onto each inferred world depth axis; yaw error and width/depth swap reported without truth-based axis reassignment.
metrics: raw and corrected 95% interval coverage,width,interval score
evaluation.failed_case_behavior: Same public unconditional uniform-density prior [0.2,1.4] and fixed world-y target axis as B8; report failure reason; no GT-best track choice.

isolation.actor_input: Sanitized observation manifest and public constants only
isolation.truth_usage: Generator and split-scoped evaluator only; calibration sees only calibration truth, test evaluator only after q frozen.

prohibited_claims: reuse of B8 heldout for model selection
